from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEpsRecord(BaseModel):
    """Diluted earnings per share for a single company from one financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share value for the period")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 2024 年第一季度)")
    source: str | None = Field(description="Where the value was found, e.g. '主要会计数据和财务指标' or '合并利润表'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_records: list[CompanyEpsRecord]
